sections.heading: How to Place?
sections.text:
Wear the Black Boxer Chain around your neck and adjust it comfortably so it sits neatly on your neckline.
You can wear it alone for a clean minimal look or pair it with your favourite pendant for a bolder statement style.
For everyday styling, match it with casual T-shirts, shirts, jackets, or ethnic outfits to add a sharp and modern touch.
Avoid contact with water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals to maintain its finish for a longer time.
Store it separately in a dry pouch or jewellery box after use to prevent scratches and tangling.

sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 

The Black Boxer Chain is designed to add a bold, clean, and modern finish to your everyday style 🖤. Its sleek black tone gives it a sharp look, making it easy to pair with different pendants, outfits, and personal aesthetics.

✨ The black finish adds a strong and stylish edge without looking too loud.✨ The boxer-style chain pattern gives it a structured, premium, and masculine feel.✨ Its lightweight design makes it comfortable for daily wear.✨ The versatile look makes it suitable for both men and women.

This chain is perfect for anyone who wants a simple yet powerful accessory that can be worn alone or paired with a pendant. Whether you are styling it with casual wear, streetwear, ethnic outfits, or statement jewellery, it blends effortlessly while still standing out.

The Black Boxer Chain carries a bold minimal look—clean, confident, and easy to wear. It is made for people who prefer accessories that feel modern, strong, and practical at the same time.

Crafted with attention to detail, this chain is lightweight, comfortable on the neck, and designed to give a neat fall when worn. Its black tone adds depth to your jewellery styling and creates a strong contrast with golden, silver, or crystal pendants.

This is more than just a chain.It’s a simple statement of confidence, style, and everyday boldness.

This chain is carefully crafted and brought to you by India’s biggest crystal home décor brand, ensuring premium finishing, wearable comfort, and fine detailing.

Made for everyday styling, the chain is designed to offer a clean look, smooth feel, and versatile appeal for different jewellery combinations.

✪ Styling Tip: Pair this black chain with gold-tone, silver-tone, or crystal pendants for a sharp contrast. Wear it with casual T-shirts, open shirts, streetwear, or ethnic layers to create a bold and effortless statement look.

Size: 60 cm

sections.text:
collapsible-row-list-item__label">
 

 
 FAQ
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Q1. Can I wear this chain with a pendant?

Yes, you can pair it with gold-tone, silver-tone, or crystal pendants for a bold and stylish look.

Q2. Is this chain suitable for men and women?

Yes, the Black Boxer Chain has a unisex design and can be styled by both men and women.

Q3. How should I style this chain?

You can wear it alone for a simple look or layer it with a pendant for a stronger statement style.

Q4. How do I take care of this chain?

Avoid water, perfume, sweat, and harsh chemicals. Store it in a dry pouch or jewellery box after use.

Q5. Is the chain heavy?

No, it is designed to feel lightweight and comfortable while still giving a bold and premium appearance.
